description: Quality gate + docs + release layout + final report (Phases 4-6). Run the full green-build gate, remove dead code, build the release/ layout with SHA256 checksums, gitignore release/, update README with Windows + Android sections, write docs/packaging.md + docs/troubleshooting.md, final git add/commit + push attempt, and write docs/PACKAGING-REPORT.md with strictly separated VERIFIED / BUILT-NOT-VERIFIED / BLOCKED / NOT-CLAIMED sections. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 being complete. This is the last implementation feature.
steps: Quality gate. Backend: cd backend; mvn clean test redirecting output to a temp log file (shell truncates), read the 'Tests run' / 'BUILD' line, delete the log. Frontend: cd frontend; npm run build; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit — all exit 0. E2E: start backend + (built static) stack as BACKGROUND processes, cd e2e; npx playwright test with the JSON reporter captured to a file, parse the pass count, delete the capture, stop the processes. Record the ACTUAL numbers (do not assume 37). Remove dead code / unused imports introduced during packaging. No Python/Ruff.
Release layout: assemble release/ containing the app-image (and the .exe if produced) + checksums.txt (SHA256 via Get-FileHash). Add release/ to .gitignore (keep scripts under windows/ tracked).

Docs: update README.md with Windows (app-image + installer status) and Android (Capacitor + APK build status) sections; create docs/packaging.md (Windows build + jpackage + installer), docs/troubleshooting.md (firewall, port-conflict, QR-shows-localhost, Android cleartext, hotspot isolation). (docs/android.md already created in FEAT-003.)

Final commit + push: git add -A (excluding generated/ignored artifacts); commit with a clear message; attempt git push origin main. If push fails (auth/network) report it and do NOT halt. Note origin/main is behind local a78d426.

Write docs/PACKAGING-REPORT.md with STRICTLY SEPARATED sections: VERIFIED (actually executed commands + outcomes), BUILT-BUT-NOT-REAL-DEVICE/REAL-INSTALL-VERIFIED, BLOCKED (exact reasons: WiX v3 not installed/safely installable here; Android SDK/ANDROID_HOME/gradle/adb absent; no device/emulator), NOT CLAIMED (real-device install/scan, hotspot AP-isolation, 100-user load, Windows reboot persistence, upgrade-preserves-data on real reinstall), plus the 22-point final report structure. NEVER write 'passed' for anything not executed — use VERIFIED / BUILT-NOT-VERIFIED / BLOCKED.
acceptance_criteria: Backend mvn clean test is green; frontend npm run build + npm run lint + npx tsc --noEmit all exit 0; the e2e pass count is recorded from the actual JSON report.
release/ exists with checksums.txt and is git-ignored (git status does not list release artifacts).
README has Windows + Android sections; docs/packaging.md and docs/troubleshooting.md exist and are consistent with the scripts.
A final commit exists; the push result (success or precise failure reason) is recorded honestly.
docs/PACKAGING-REPORT.md separates VERIFIED / BUILT-NOT-VERIFIED / BLOCKED / NOT-CLAIMED and names the exact missing tool for every blocked item.
